newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NatWest eyeing BOE stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: NatWest eyeing BOE stake - paper.

text.p: Britain's National Westminster Bank Plc is set to buy a big stake in South African financial services group, The Board of Executors Ltd (BOE), Business Report newspaper said on Thursday.
Officials from the companies were not immediately availble for comment.

The nenwspaper report follows a statement from BOE and holding company BOE Corp Ltd on Wednesday that they were in unspecified negotiations which if successfully concluded could have an effect on their share prices.
That statement lifted BOE shares to a record high of 93 rand in a buoyant financial services sector on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
BOE and NatWest already have a South African joint venture, BOE NatWest, incorporating stockbroking and corporate finance.
